dct_description_sm: This multi-year project aimed to raise awareness and plan measures to respond to climate change impacts in the Xeni Gwet'in Caretaker Area, an area susceptible to forest fire, flooding, drought, fish and wildlife decline, thus increasing the long-term adaptive capacity of the community to remain self-sufficient and sustainable. Focus was directed to the capacity of the Chilko and Nemiah airstrip, the fencing/cleaning of Nemiah Creek, and education on the subject of water protection and climate change partnered with a rainfall collection and irrigation project. The specific objectives of the project were: (1) identifying the climate change impacts and vulnerabilities faced in the Xeni Gwet'in community; (2) raising awareness of climate change impacts in the Xeni Gwet'in community and surrounding region; (3) determining and initiating climate change adaptation measures to reduce the risks and impacts; (4) determining resources for adaptation measures; (5) developing an action plan to be implemented by the community over the next 20 years; (6) developing monitoring protocols to measure impacts over the next 10 years; and (7) developing partnerships with other communities and agencies.   In its first year (Phase I), the project focused on all of the above-mentioned objectives. In its second year (Phase II), the project focused on implementation of the Adaptation Strategy & Action Plan.
